programmes.t: RiffTrax Presents: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programmes.d: It's double-ya double-ya two and Sherlock Holmes once again faces Professor Moriarty - with nothing less than the future of England at stake! This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

programmes.d: Please join Mike, Kevin, Bill for Merlin's Shop of Mystical Wonders. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programmes.t: RiffTrax: Manos the Hands of Fate (SV)
programmes.d: Many years ago the people of El Paso, Texas gave their money to a local fertilizer salesman and said, “Go make us the best horror movie you can make.” The result is an object lesson in why you should never give your money to an El Paso fertilizer salesman

RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 2000 era horror classic where survivors of a plane crash battle it out Starship Troopers style against a giant bug attack!
Fairy King of Ar is a delightful journey into the magical land of fairies. It starts with Grandma dropping dead and dad contracting emphysema.
Grab a Juicy Fruit and join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for Copper Mountain! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programmes.t: Rifftrax Shorts: David and Hazel: A Story in Communication
programmes.d: Let Mike, Kevin, and Bill invite David and Hazel into your home. This feature parodies the original movie by combining it with comedic commentary from Mike, Kevin, and Bill of RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

Bridget and Mary Jo leave it all on the field with yet another Teen-Agers film, High School Hero, featuring zero actual teenagers. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

Birdemic is one of our favorite bad movies of all time, and there's no better way to watch it than RiffTrax Live. So grab a coat hanger, fire up your solar powered TV and for the love of god fully vest your stock options! Birdemic!

programmes.t: Three Riffer Edition: Night of the Living Dead
programmes.d: Shocking at the time for its graphic portrayal of the titular living dead feasting on pieces of the dead without even a hint of table manners or personal hygiene, what is most startling is the performance of the guy who looks like Joaquin Phoenix.
